description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the CustomerDao component in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The file contains test cases for CRUD operations, search filters, and access control related to Customer entities, using a test fixture setup.

classes.name: CustomerDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the CustomerDao class, verifying CRUD operations, filtering, deletion, and access control within the Time plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes CustomerDao and ProjectDao instances before each test.

methods.name: populateCustomerServiceFixture
methods.description: Loads customer fixture data for tests.

methods.name: populateCustomerDaoFixture
methods.description: Loads customer DAO fixture data for tests.

methods.name: testAddCustomer
methods.description: Tests adding a new customer and verifies the returned object and its properties.

methods.name: testGetCustomerList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of customers with default filters.

methods.name: testGetCustomerById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a customer by ID.

methods.name: testGetCustomerByIdOnNull
methods.description: Tests behavior when retrieving a non-existent customer by ID.

methods.name: testGetCustomer
methods.description: Tests getting a customer object by a non-existent ID.

methods.name: testUpdateCustomer
methods.description: Verifies updating a customer's properties and saving.

methods.name: testDeleteCustomer
methods.description: Tests deleting customers and verify associated project count.

methods.name: testGetCustomerIdList
methods.description: Tests retrieving list of customer IDs with and without filters.

methods.name: testGetCustomerIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Tests retrieving customer IDs accessible to a project admin with various scenarios.

methods.name: testExceptionForDeleteCustomer
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when deleteCustomer encounters an error.

methods.name: testGetUnselectableCustomerIds
methods.description: Verifies obtaining IDs of customers that cannot be selected.
